draft.subject: Following up on the Junior Engineer, Product Infrastructure posting
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas, a recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. I came across NIKSUN's Junior Engineer, Product Infrastructure posting and wanted to reach out directly, since I noticed it has been live for over 30 days and wasn't sure if it's still being actively filled.

My background includes hands-on C/C++ systems work: I built distributed MPI pipelines achieving up to 30x speedup through custom work-distribution scheduling across multiple parallel strategies, and a separate MPI-based simulation achieving a 10.49x speedup across 12 worker processes on a SLURM-managed cluster. I've also architected multi-stage processing pipelines with custom memory management and concurrency in a prior research role, improving output quality from a PSNR of 65 to 86.

If the Product Infrastructure opening is no longer active, I'd really appreciate hearing whether there's any other role at NIKSUN where my C/C++, Linux, and performance-engineering background could be a fit -- and your recruiting background made you the right person to ask directly rather than guess.

I'd welcome the chance to connect briefly and share my resume, whichever way this goes.
draft.hook_used: Recruiter role at the company posting the role -- asking directly about posting status and fit
